description: React component for a deployment status bar chart with interactive features, utilizing recharts library and custom theming, displaying deployment counts by status with tooltips, legend, and click interactions.

methods.name: CustomTooltip
methods.description: Renders custom tooltip for the bar chart, showing deployment status and count.

methods.name: ValueLabel
methods.description: Displays the count value above each bar in the chart.

methods.name: auditLogInteraction
methods.description: Logs user interactions such as bar and legend clicks for auditing purposes.
